text:
maria.partnerships: Heads up — CloudScale batch usage feeds are arriving outside our 24h ingest window and that's creating entitlement mismatches + negative ledger deltas. Sample line from their dump: `usage_id=abc123 arrival_time=2024-03-11T02:14:23Z reported_time=2024-03-10T23:59:01Z`

jordan-engineering: Thanks. Any idea on scale and whether these were delivery errors or upstream retries?

maria.partnerships: Rough numbers: ~8k events yesterday, ~2% are >24h late. Partner says a regional gateway firmware update caused backpressure and retried deliveries.

ingest-bot: DELIVERY FAILURE — webhook cloudscale/usage POST 502 x87 attempts; last status 2024-03-11T02:10:05Z

pete-ops: Can we accept late events if partner includes `reported_time` + `idempotency_key`? We need a documented backfill policy before we ingest.

jordan-engineering: Current reconcile intentionally ignores `reported_time` if outside the 24h window. Quick mitigation: feature-flag a 72h window for CloudScale and run a reconciliation job to backfill entitlements.

maria.partnerships: Partner will add `X-Retry-After` header and include original timestamps in payloads. They're asking for SLA credits if we drop events — we need decision rules.

carmen-bizops: We should avoid blanket credits. If partner can show retries and timely pushes, we can make allowances. Need criteria: proof of retry, no signature tampering, and small % of late events.

jordan-engineering: Implementation notes for the PR: - accept `reported_time` when present - per-partner feature flag to extend acceptance window to 72h - enforce dedupe by `usage_id`/`partner_id` (idempotency) - log `arrival_time` vs `reported_time` for audit. Example verification header usage: `X-Partner-Signature: sha256=...`

Example curl snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://ingest.redwood.ai/webhook/cloudscale \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H 'X-Partner-Signature: sha256=...' \n  -d @payload.json
```

pete-ops: Ops checklist: (1) enable ff:cloudscale-72h-ingest (2) add metric `late_events_by_partner` + dashboard (3) pager rule if >1% late over 1h -> page oncall (4) runbackfill job in maintenance window

maria.partnerships: I'll ask CloudScale to provide a CSV export for the 48h gap they saw and an incident timeline. Will coordinate comms so partners know expected cutover behavior.

jordan-engineering: I'll open the PR to accept `reported_time` + reconcile; assigning to @dana-engineering for idempotency store work. ETA: end of day tomorrow for the PR, runbackfill scheduled after QA.

dana-engineering: Acknowledged. Plan: Redis-based idempotency keys TTL=7d, dedupe logic by `usage_id`+`partner_id`, stable hashing for shard affinity. Will add integration test for out-of-order arrival.

maria.partnerships: Great — once PR merges I'll coordinate a short runbook and post to #partnership-runbooks and share the link with CloudScale.

carmen-bizops: Recording decision: we will ingest late events up to 72h while FF enabled, require `reported_time` + `idempotency_key` + signature, and evaluate credits only if partner shows >95% retry coverage and <0.5% data loss on reconciliation.

maria.partnerships: Sounds good. I'll draft an SLA addendum and loop legal if partner requests credits. Posting follow-ups in the channel: https://docs.internal/redwood/runbooks/marketplace-backfill :thumbsup:

jordan-engineering: FYI I'll add a short telemetry event `metering.late.accepted` with partner_id and lag_bucket.

dana-engineering: Putting a TODO in the PR to surface raw payloads to audit logs for accepted backfills.

maria.partnerships: Thanks all — will update once CloudScale sends the CSV and confirms header changes. :handshake:
